# TrainLens 0.17.0

TrainLens 0.17.0 focuses on **lossless experiment evidence** and safer downstream decisions.

Portable runs now retain complete metric trajectories and steps, and every consumer keeps training, validation, and held-out test metrics distinct. Ambiguous metric selectors fail explicitly rather than silently collapsing splits.

This release also tightens the experimental layer: repeated-seed parameter effects avoid pseudo-replication, multi-objective leaderboards only rank runs with complete objective data, portable JSON rejects non-finite/boolean metric values, Agent Context is deeply immutable, and Project writes are serialized for parallel training jobs.

Evidence identifiers for summaries, signals, and dataset findings are now semantic rather than positional, making agent plans less sensitive to simple finding reordering.
